newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen mixed, profit-taking expected.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen mixed, profit-taking expected.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are likely to be mixed on Wednesday on expected profit-taking from small investors and selective institutional buying, brokers said.
"The market may have selling pressure by small investors who plan to book profits. Some blue chips that gained over the past few sessions may fall on profit taking," said broker Shakil Rizvi.
The DSE all-share price index closed up 17.5 points or 1.58 percent at 1,119.87 on turnover of 79.5 million taka on Tuesday.
